# New Product “VOCALOID6 Voicebank HATSUNE MIKU V6” now on sale

![Image 1: HATUNE MIKU V6 Apr 14th, 2026 Release](https://www.vocaloid.com/en/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/03/img_news_top-960x493.jpg)

Thank you very much for your continued support of VOCALOID.  
We are pleased to announce that VOCALOID6 Voicebank "HATSUNE MIKU V6" will be available from today.

[Voicebank (VOCALOID6 Editor Lite included)](https://www.vocaloid.com/en/products/show/v6vb_hatsune_miku_v6_c)

### 【Demo Movie】

[Video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fPFPYKCmhqs)

“HATSUNE MIKU V6” Demo Song

[Video 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Aut5VO6mz1g)

“HATSUNE MIKU V6” Demo Song English Version

[Video 3](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w0zXuIvA5wY)

“HATSUNE MIKU V6” Anniversary Song

### 【Product Description】

**Achieve natural vocal performance with generated parameters.**  
**Hatsune Miku sings fluently with just lyrics and melody input.**

“HATSUNE MIKU V6” is a virtual singer software compatible with VOCALOID6, featuring Hatsune Miku’s voicebank (supports Japanese and English / Chinese support planned for a future update).  
Optimized for the VOCALOID:AI singing synthesis engine, it offers features such as intelligently adding breaths automatically, and automatically assigning English singing when you enter English spelling in the lyrics.  
In addition, because it uses machine learning to learn pitch transitions, volume transitions, timing, accents, and more, it excels at producing natural, organic vocal expressions.  
The generated vocals can then be edited flexibly; you can adjust expressions such as scoops, vibrato, and accents while referencing visual pitch and volume curves; create harmony parts using the TAKE function; and control vocal strength and firmness using the Expression parameter.  
It allows you to shape the singing flexibly, as if you were directly giving singing instructions to the virtual singer “Hatsune Miku.”

This product includes VOCALOID6 Editor Lite*, so you can enjoy creating singing voices just by purchasing this product.

**VOCALOID6 Editor Lite is a limited version of VOCALOID6 Editor. It can only be used in standalone mode and can be used with a maximum of 2 tracks (VOCALOID:AI track or VOCALOID track, and Audio Track).

[Voicebank (VOCALOID6 Editor Lite included)](https://www.vocaloid.com/en/products/show/v6vb_hatsune_miku_v6_c)

It is downloadable from this official VOCALOID SHOP.  
*Voicebank products cannot be used stand-alone; separate editor software such as the VOCALOID6 Version 6.12.0 or higher / VOCALOID6 Editor Lite is required.

We are pleased to announce that VOCALOID6 Voicebank "HATSUNE MIKU V6" will be available from today.

### 【Product Description】

**Achieve natural vocal performance with generated parameters.**  
**Hatsune Miku sings fluently with just lyrics and melody input.**

“HATSUNE MIKU V6” is a virtual singer software compatible with VOCALOID6, featuring Hatsune Miku’s voicebank (supports Japanese and English / Chinese support planned for a future update).  
Optimized for the VOCALOID:AI singing synthesis engine, it offers features such as intelligently adding breaths automatically, and automatically assigning English singing when you enter English spelling in the lyrics.  
In addition, because it uses machine learning to learn pitch transitions, volume transitions, timing, accents, and more, it excels at producing natural, organic vocal expressions.  
The generated vocals can then be edited flexibly; you can adjust expressions such as scoops, vibrato, and accents while referencing visual pitch and volume curves; create harmony parts using the TAKE function; and control vocal strength and firmness using the Expression parameter.  
It allows you to shape the singing flexibly, as if you were directly giving singing instructions to the virtual singer “Hatsune Miku.”

This product includes VOCALOID6 Editor Lite*, so you can enjoy creating singing voices just by purchasing this product.

**VOCALOID6 Editor Lite is a limited version of VOCALOID6 Editor. It can only be used in standalone mode and can be used with a maximum of 2 tracks (VOCALOID:AI track or VOCALOID track, and Audio Track).

[Voicebank (VOCALOID6 Editor Lite included)](https://www.vocaloid.com/en/products/show/v6vb_hatsune_miku_v6_c)

It is downloadable from this official VOCALOID SHOP.  
*Voicebank products cannot be used stand-alone; separate editor software such as the VOCALOID6 Version 6.12.0 or higher / VOCALOID6 Editor Lite is required.

## Features

Fuiro is a voice bank recorded and produced exclusively for VOCALOID:AI..  
 It is characterised by its high tone, strong voice and dynamic voice tonal changes.   
  
 VOCALOID6 uses VOCALOID:AI, an AI-based technology that makes it possible to generate even more natural-sounding and highly expressive singing voices.  
 Just input the melody and the lyrics, and this technology transforms your computer into a fabulous vocalist.   
  
 VOCALOID6 Features:  
 - VOCALOID:AI   
 VOCALOID:AI makes it possible to generate highly expressive singing voices.   
  
 - VOCALO CHANGER   
 VOCALO CHANGER offers new options for vocal production.   
 The voice bank for VOCALOID6 replicates your singing style with superb fidelity.   
  
 - VST/AU plugins and standalone versions (Windows/Mac)   
  
 - ARA2 supported  
  
 - VOCALOID3, VOCALOID4 and VOCALOID5 Voicebanks supported *  
 * VOCALOID2 is not supported.  
  
 - Included with Cubase AI  
  
  
 VOCALOID6 has 22 voicebanks.  
 HARUKA, AKITO, ALLEN, SARAH, ASAHI, SAKURA, SHION, TAKU, MICHELLE, LUCAS, YUINA, NAOKI, JESSICA, MATTHEW, BRIAN, SANDORA,KANA and HAYATO English-Japanese male and female voicebanks newly developed for VOCALOID6.  
 Depending on your direction, you can create a variety of singing voices, from natural human-like voices to futuristic robot voices.  
 In addition to the VOCALOID6 voicebanks, this product includes the Amy, Chris, Kaori and Ken voicebanks from VOCALOID5.

## Features

The "ZOLA Project" voicebank consists of the voices of characters KYO, YUU, and WIL, who make up a three-person male vocal group.   
Take advantage of the individuality of these three unique voices to enjoy creating VOCALOID songs using a single voicebank. Mix and match the voices freely to sing solos, duos, as a three-person group, or in chorus with other voices when used in combination with other voicebanks. The possible musical variations are endless, limited only by the imagination of the creator. The qualities and specialty genres for each voice are listed below.  
  
 KYO  
 Bright and positive  
 Specialty genres: Pop, Rock, Electronic  
  
 YUU  
 Soft and ephemeral  
 Specialty genres: Pop, Dance, Jazz  
  
 WIL  
 Moderate and husky  
 Specialty genres: Pop, R&B, Ballads   
  
 VOCALOID6 Editor Lite* is included with this product, so you can enjoy VOCALOID singing voice as soon as you purchase this one.  
 However, please obtain VOCALOID6 Editor Lite from the official Internet Inc. website.  
  
 *VOCALOID6 Editor Lite is a limited version of VOCALOID6 Editor. It can only be used in standalone mode and can be used with a maximum of 2 tracks (VOCALOID:AI track or VOCALOID track, and Audio Track).

## Features

The "ZOLA Project" voicebank consists of the voices of characters KYO, YUU, and WIL, who make up a three-person male vocal group.   
Take advantage of the individuality of these three unique voices to enjoy creating VOCALOID songs using a single voicebank. Mix and match the voices freely to sing solos, duos, as a three-person group, or in chorus with other voices when used in combination with other voicebanks. The possible musical variations are endless, limited only by the imagination of the creator. The qualities and specialty genres for each voice are listed below.  
  
 KYO  
 Bright and positive  
 Specialty genres: Pop, Rock, Electronic  
  
 YUU  
 Soft and ephemeral  
 Specialty genres: Pop, Dance, Jazz  
  
 WIL  
 Moderate and husky  
 Specialty genres: Pop, R&B, Ballads   
  
 VOCALOID6 Editor Lite* is included with this product, so you can enjoy VOCALOID singing voice as soon as you purchase this one.
